name: Wyvern
languages: Understands Common plus one other language

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult

traits.name: Terrain
traits.text: It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the wraith has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the xorn doesn’t disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.text: The xorn can pinpoint the location of precious metals and stones within 60 feet of itself.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.text: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The wyvern makes one Bite attack and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the wyvern’s next turn. Xorn Xorn
